facts.fact: MTN Ghana, a private mobile operator, committed US$1.1 billion over three years to 5G rollout, network expansion and fintech growth in Ghana, of which about US$380 million is to be deployed in 2026 including around 800 new sites, per its CEO; financier's origin is not stated and the year is taken from the 2026 launch statement of 2026-05-14.
